bearingSource: OSM way 16291602 long axis 55.2°; +X points north-east: the portico protrusion of the outline is at the south-west end (−X), facing the garden as in photos 08–09; rotunda centred on the outline
approximations: Total height 41 m from OSM/Wikidata; other heights scaled from photos 01, 02, 08 and 10 (drum cornice ≈ 25.9 m, crown base ≈ 31 m, wing cornice ≈ 14 m, pediment apex ≈ 19.4 m, ±1 m). Drum Ø ≈ 28.8 m with 18 bays (oculus on the portico axis) counted from photo 10. Dome modelled as a spherical cap (profile from photo silhouettes); 18 ribs simplified to pedestal + console + volute + roll; 8 standing seams per pan; crown cresting, swags, finial scrolls, wreaths, lyres, capitals and the portico griffins reduced to primitives; frieze names omitted. Wing side and rear elevations and the two rear pavilion roofs are not photographed (mirrored from the front); the rear edge of the OSM outline is skewed — the rear is modelled square (model ≈ 59 m long vs 67.3 m in OSM). The portico roof is assumed to run back to the rotunda. Wing roofs shown in the same grey metal as photographed; only the dome is documented as COLOR METAL natural titanium-zinc.

note.ro: Machetă detaliată după fotografiile de referință: rotonda cu 18 travee, cupola din titan-zinc natural (patinată gri-albăstrui) cu 18 nervuri, coroana și portalul ionic; fațadele laterale și posterioare ale aripilor nu sunt fotografiate și sunt aproximate, iar ornamentele sunt simplificate.
note.hu: A referenciafotók alapján készült részletes makett: a 18 mezős rotunda, a 18 bordás natúr titáncink kupola (kékesszürkére patinásodva), a korona és az ión portikusz; a szárnyak oldal- és hátsó homlokzatai nem szerepelnek a fotókon, ezért közelítőek, a díszítés egyszerűsített.
note.en: Detailed scale model from the reference photographs: the 18-bay rotunda, the 18-rib natural titanium-zinc dome (weathered blue-grey), its crown and the Ionic portico; the wings' side and rear elevations were not photographed and are approximated, ornament is simplified.
